title: Agent Capabilities and Tools
summary: This module defines the core capabilities and tool management mechanisms for AI agents, enabling structured output, tool discovery, lifecycle hooks, and integration with native or external tools. It provides a flexible framework for extending agent behavior and interacting with various services.

nodes.label: Check for RunContext
nodes.title: Check for RunContext Argument
nodes.description: Determines if a given callable object accepts a `RunContext` as its first argument, which is crucial for context-aware operations within the agent framework.

nodes.label: Validate Single Argument
nodes.title: Validate Single Argument Input
nodes.description: Validates a single argument, handling both plain unwrapped model input and wrapped envelope formats, with a fallback mechanism for re-validation after round-trips.

nodes.label: Define Output Structure
nodes.title: Agent Output Schema Definition
nodes.description: Abstract base class for defining the structure and processing of agent outputs, supporting various output types like text, tools, deferred requests, and images. It orchestrates the building of output processors and toolsets.

nodes.label: Manage Output Tools
nodes.title: Output Toolset Management
nodes.description: A specialized toolset for managing output tools, which define how an agent's final output should be structured. It handles tool definitions, processors, and retry logic for output-specific operations.

nodes.label: Validate Output Results
nodes.title: Output Validation Logic
nodes.description: Encapsulates a function for validating agent output results, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous validation, and handling `RunContext` awareness.

nodes.label: Structured Text Output
nodes.title: Structured Text Output Schema
nodes.description: An abstract base class for output schemas that produce structured text, combining an object processor with an optional template for generating instructions based on the output's JSON schema.

nodes.label: Capability Specification
nodes.title: Agent Capability Specification
nodes.description: A specification class for agent capabilities, used for schema generation where it's replaced by the full capability Union type.

nodes.label: Narrow Native Search Call
nodes.title: Narrow Native Tool Search Call
nodes.description: Narrows a native tool call part to a native tool search call part, validating its arguments for tool search operations.

nodes.label: Narrow Native Search Return
nodes.title: Narrow Native Tool Search Return
nodes.description: Narrows a native tool return part to a native tool search return part, validating its content for tool search results.

nodes.label: Narrow Tool Search Call
nodes.title: Narrow Tool Search Call
nodes.description: Narrows a generic tool call part to a tool search call part, validating its arguments for tool search operations.

nodes.label: Narrow Tool Search Return
nodes.title: Narrow Tool Search Return
nodes.description: Narrows a generic tool return part to a tool search return part, validating its content for tool search results.

nodes.label: Sort Capabilities
nodes.title: Capability Ordering and Sorting
nodes.description: Sorts a sequence of capabilities based on their declared ordering constraints, ensuring proper execution flow and raising errors for conflicts or missing requirements.

nodes.label: Drain Pending Messages
nodes.title: Pending Message Drainage
nodes.description: A capability that manages and drains pending messages (e.g., 'asap' or 'when_idle') into model requests or redirects, ensuring messages are processed at appropriate times during an agent's run.

nodes.label: Discover Deferred Tools
nodes.title: Tool Discovery Capability
nodes.description: Enables tool discovery for large toolsets, hiding deferred tools until they are found. It supports various search strategies, including native model support and local keyword matching.

nodes.label: Base Agent Capability
nodes.title: Abstract Agent Capability
nodes.description: The foundational abstract class for all agent capabilities, defining a common interface for reusable agent behaviors and lifecycle hooks.

nodes.label: Handle Deferred Tool Calls
nodes.title: Deferred Tool Call Handler
nodes.description: A capability that intercepts and resolves deferred tool calls (e.g., approval-required or external execution) using a user-provided handler function, allowing the agent run to continue automatically.

nodes.label: Register Agent Hooks
nodes.title: Agent Lifecycle Hooks
nodes.description: Provides a flexible mechanism to register hook functions for various agent lifecycle events (run, node, model request, tool validation/execution, output processing) using decorators or constructor arguments.

nodes.label: Hook Wrapper Function
nodes.title: Internal Hook Wrapper
nodes.description: Internal helper function used by the `Hooks` capability to wrap and call registered hook functions, ensuring proper context and argument passing.

nodes.label: Hook Wrapper (No Arg)
nodes.title: Internal Hook Wrapper (No Arg)
nodes.description: Internal helper function for `Hooks` to wrap and call registered hook functions that do not require an argument to be passed to the handler.

nodes.label: Hook Registration Decorator
nodes.title: Hook Registration Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator used internally by the `Hooks` capability to register hook functions with specific keys and optional timeouts or tool filters.

nodes.label: Include Tool Return Schemas
nodes.title: Tool Return Schema Inclusion
nodes.description: A capability that configures selected tools to include their return type schemas in the information provided to the model, enhancing the model's understanding of tool outputs.

nodes.label: Instrument Agent Runs
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry Instrumentation
nodes.description: Provides OpenTelemetry/Logfire tracing for agent runs, model requests, and tool executions, allowing for detailed monitoring and observability of agent behavior.

nodes.label: MCP Server Integration
nodes.title: Model Context Protocol Integration
nodes.description: Integrates with an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, using native model support when available or falling back to a local HTTP connection for tool execution.

nodes.label: Native/Local Tool Pairing
nodes.title: Native or Local Tool Capability
nodes.description: A capability that pairs a provider-native tool with a local fallback, dynamically choosing which to use based on model support. It allows for flexible tool integration.

nodes.label: Process Event Stream
nodes.title: Agent Event Stream Processor
nodes.description: Forwards the agent's event stream to a user-provided asynchronous handler or processor, allowing for observation, modification, or transformation of agent events during streaming and tool execution.

nodes.label: Set Tool Metadata
nodes.title: Tool Metadata Assignment
nodes.description: A capability that merges specified metadata key-value pairs onto selected tools, allowing for dynamic annotation and configuration of tool definitions.

nodes.label: Configure Model Thinking
nodes.title: Model Thinking Configuration
nodes.description: Enables and configures the model's thinking or reasoning capabilities, using a unified setting that works across different providers while allowing provider-specific overrides.

nodes.label: Custom Thread Executor
nodes.title: Custom Thread Pool Executor
nodes.description: Allows the use of a custom `ThreadPoolExecutor` or any `Executor` for running synchronous functions in threads, preventing thread accumulation in long-running servers.

nodes.label: Web Fetching Capability
nodes.title: URL Fetching Capability
nodes.description: Provides URL fetching functionality, utilizing native model support when available or falling back to a local function tool (e.g., markdownify-based fetch) with domain restrictions.

nodes.label: Web Search Capability
nodes.title: Web Search Integration
nodes.description: Integrates web search functionality, leveraging native model support or falling back to a local search tool (e.g., DuckDuckGo) with options for context size, location, and domain filtering.

nodes.label: Wrap Agent Capability
nodes.title: Capability Wrapper
nodes.description: A capability that wraps another capability, delegating all methods and allowing subclasses to override specific behaviors while maintaining the core functionality of the wrapped capability.

nodes.label: Function Signature Definition
nodes.title: Function Signature Representation
nodes.description: Represents a function's signature, including parameters, return type, and referenced type definitions, enabling rendering of function signatures from JSON schemas and handling type conflicts.

nodes.label: Manage Agent Tools
nodes.title: Agent Tool Management
nodes.description: Manages tools for an agent run step, handling tool definitions, argument validation, execution, and retry logic. It orchestrates the interaction between the agent and its available tools.

nodes.label: Keyword Search Algorithm
nodes.title: Keyword Overlap Search
nodes.description: A built-in keyword-overlap search algorithm used by the `ToolSearch` capability to discover tools based on matching keywords in their names or descriptions.

nodes.label: Base Toolset
nodes.title: Abstract Toolset Definition
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all toolsets, defining the interface for managing collections of tools, including listing, validating arguments, and calling tools within an agent's context.

nodes.label: Deprecated External Toolset
nodes.title: Deprecated External Toolset Alias
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for `ExternalToolset`, maintained for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: FastMCP Toolset (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Deprecated FastMCP Toolset
nodes.description: A toolset backed by a FastMCP `Client` for calling tools on a local or remote MCP server. This class is deprecated in favor of `MCPToolset`.

nodes.label: Wrap Toolset
nodes.title: Toolset Wrapper
nodes.description: A toolset that wraps another toolset, delegating all methods and allowing subclasses to modify behavior while preserving the wrapped toolset's core functionality.

nodes.label: Deprecated Web Fetch Tool
nodes.title: Deprecated URL Context Tool
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for `WebFetchTool`, maintained for backward compatibility. It overrides the tool kind for deserialization of older payloads.

nodes.label: Native Code Execution
nodes.title: Native Code Execution Tool
nodes.description: A native tool that enables the agent to execute code, supported by various LLM providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, and xAI.

nodes.label: Native Memory Tool
nodes.title: Native Memory Tool
nodes.description: A native tool that allows the agent to utilize memory, currently supported by Anthropic.

nodes.label: Native File Search
nodes.title: Native File Search Tool
nodes.description: A native tool for vector-based search through uploaded files, providing a managed RAG system for file storage, chunking, embedding, and context injection.

nodes.label: Exa Search Toolset
nodes.title: Exa Search Integration
nodes.description: A toolset providing Exa search tools (search, find_similar, get_contents, answer) with a shared client for efficient web data retrieval.

nodes.label: Tavily Search Tool
nodes.title: Tavily Web Search Tool
nodes.description: A function that creates a Tavily search tool, allowing agents to perform web searches with configurable parameters like max results, search depth, and domain filtering.

nodes.label: Tool Definition
nodes.title: Tool Definition Structure
nodes.description: Defines the structure and metadata of a tool, including its name, description, parameters, return schema, and other configuration.

nodes.label: Run Context
nodes.title: Agent Run Context
nodes.description: Provides contextual information for the current agent run, including messages, dependencies, and retry counts, enabling context-aware operations.

nodes.label: LLM Model
nodes.title: Language Model Abstraction
nodes.description: Represents an abstract interface for interacting with various Large Language Models, handling requests, responses, and streaming.

nodes.label: Abstract Agent
nodes.title: Base Agent Interface
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all agents, defining the fundamental interface for agent creation, configuration, and execution.

groups.label: Output Management
groups.title: Agent Output Management
groups.description: Components responsible for defining, structuring, validating, and processing the agent's outputs, including text, structured data, and tool calls.

groups.label: Capability Core
groups.title: Core Agent Capability Framework
groups.description: Fundamental components that define the structure, lifecycle, and management of agent capabilities, enabling modular and extensible agent behaviors.

groups.label: Tool Management
groups.title: Agent Tool Orchestration
groups.description: Components for managing, defining, and executing tools available to the agent, including abstract interfaces, wrappers, and specific toolset implementations.

groups.label: Native/Local Tool Integration
groups.title: Integrating Native and Local Tools
groups.description: Capabilities for seamlessly integrating tools that are either natively supported by the LLM provider or implemented locally, with fallback mechanisms.

groups.label: Agent Lifecycle Hooks
groups.title: Agent Execution Lifecycle Hooks
groups.description: Components that provide hooks and mechanisms to observe, modify, and control the agent's execution flow at various stages, from run initiation to tool execution and event processing.

groups.label: Tool Configuration
groups.title: Tool Discovery and Configuration
groups.description: Capabilities focused on how tools are discovered, presented to the model, and configured, including search strategies, metadata assignment, and model thinking settings.
